vectors.name: formats-json/nonfinite/bare-nan-token-is-a-codec-syntax-error
vectors.comment: C-19: JSON has no spelling for NaN or an infinity, so the bare token `NaN` is not JSON and the read fails with `parse.codec-syntax` at a text position (E-32 placeholder); a reader that accepts the token builds a Document its own writer cannot write back (E-6). Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Go, Java; fails on Rust (DIV-45, expected until adopted).
